question: May one isolated local diagnostic QE 7.2 build and exactly one trapping C48 SCF invocation be performed to localize the first IEEE invalid, divide-by-zero, or overflow operation?

options.summary: Build one isolated debug/trapping QE 7.2 pw.x and run the exact retained C48 SCF input once.
options.consequence: Use the unchanged source snapshot at ~/projects/q-e-qe-7.2 to create only ~/projects/q-e-diagnostics/qe-7.2-ieee-20260920T173542Z/build. Configure a Debug MPI-on/OpenMP-off build with mpicc/mpif90 and GNU Fortran -O0 -g -fbacktrace -ffpe-trap=invalid,zero,overflow, preserving the existing FFTW and Apple Accelerate linkage, then compile only target qe_pw_exe with at most eight local build jobs. Stage the exact C48 SCF input (SHA-256 cadb2a3024f39858f91b23bd1c1c22e2b2d0f161f2960c39ea1abf48cf00ee17) and exact installed Si.upf (SHA-256 39822757f53f36e3bf3bfb779356152a8d3f21199c7db9dd5a931e5d18c45282) under ~/projects/ksdft2effmass-runs/bulk-silicon-ieee-diagnostic-20260920T173542Z. Invoke the diagnostic pw.x directly exactly once with one singleton MPI process, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, and a two-minute wall-time limit. Allow up to 30 minutes, eight local jobs, 8 GiB memory, and 4 GiB storage for the build; observe 500 MB resident memory and a 250 MB run-workspace envelope for the invocation. Retain build logs and identity, compiler/runtime/link metadata, input identities, streams, exit or signal, backtrace, timing, and compact artifact inventory outside Git, plus a compact repository diagnosis. Stop after that invocation whether it traps or completes; do not retry, trap underflow in this first pass, execute QE 7.5, inspect dense outputs, activate a successor, or use network, remote, cluster, or cloud resources.

options.consequence: Preserve the read-only diagnosis, provisional settings, and current downstream block. The first flag-raising operation and effect on retained observables remain unlocalized.
